rag_behavior.retrieval_rule: First identify the requested district and interest. Read that district's interest_summary. If has_match is true, return only matching entities from that district. If has_match is false, state that the district has no matching destination in this dataset and suggest fallback_districts. Do not invent a place.
rag_behavior.district_filter_rule: Never return a place from another district as if it belongs to the selected district.
rag_behavior.interest_filter_rule: Only return an entity when the selected interest appears in the entity's interests array.
rag_behavior.no_match_rule: When there is no match, clearly say so and recommend districts from fallback_districts that do contain that interest.
rag_behavior.accommodation_rule: Accommodation is admin-curated. If accommodations is empty, respond exactly: 'No accommodations are currently listed for this district.' Never generate hotel names from memory.
rag_behavior.admin_curated_rule: If an admin-curated location list is empty, respond: 'No other tourism locations have been added for this district yet.'
rag_behavior.hallucination_rule: Never create a tourist spot, hotel, restaurant, price, address, phone number, rating or opening hour that is absent from retrieved data.
